title: Property ombudsman calls for integrated regulation system
summary:
The Property Ombudsman has outlined the need for closer integration between regulation and redress mechanisms as the government prepares to introduce independent regulation of property agents in the UK. Chief ombudsman Lesley Horton stated that whilst regulation presents opportunities to drive sector improvements, it must work alongside redress providers to deliver meaningful consumer protection.

title: UK rental prices fall across most regions in September
summary:
Rental prices declined across all but one region in England, Wales and Scotland during September, according to data released by Propertymark. Scotland recorded the largest monthly decrease at 3.4%, bringing average rents to £1,134.

title: Unite Group lowers student rents for first time in 25 years
summary:
Unite Group has reduced student rents by 0.3% for the current academic year, the first decline in over 25 years outside of Covid-19. The UK's largest student accommodation provider cited falling international student numbers and more British students living at home as key factors.

title: Connells Group reports progress on branch refurbishment programme
summary:
Connells Group has completed or neared completion on 38 branch refurbishments as part of its ongoing estate modernisation programme, with a further 50 branches scheduled for upgrades in 2027. The estate agency group operates approximately 1,200 branches across 87 brands.

title: Durham landlord fined £28,500 over property conditions
summary:
A landlord operating through Dalziel Ventures has been fined £28,500 following prosecution by Durham County Council after a property in Annfield Plain was found to have multiple hazards. Kristoffer Jon Dalziel failed to carry out ordered repairs and obtain selective licences for three properties.

title: Property expert calls for stamp duty reform alongside housing schemes
summary:
A senior property adviser has warned that government initiatives to support first-time buyers will fall short without comprehensive reform of the UK's stamp duty system. Stephen Hemmings of Menzies LLP argues current tax rates deter the investment needed to deliver new housing supply.

title: Founding members acquire majority stake in Ethical Agent Network
summary:
Two founding members of the Ethical Agent Network have acquired a majority stake in the organisation, marking a shift in ownership for the industry body launched in March 2024. Nick Cheshire and Dan Kirby, who operate Nest estate agency in Essex, have purchased the controlling interest in the network.

title: Economic pressures raise concerns for UK property market
summary:
Mixed signals are emerging from the UK property market as economic headwinds intensify, with industry observers reporting divergent experiences between statistical performance and on-the-ground trading conditions. Market data indicates approximately 1.2 million homes are on target to be sold this year, while some participants report challenging conditions requiring substantial price reductions.

title: Storm damage payouts surge 32% as winter weather threatens UK homes
summary:
Storm damage payouts to UK homeowners increased 32% to £244m in 2025 following severe weather events. Total weather-related claims for damage to homes and possessions reached £758m last year, according to the Association of British Insurers.

title: CRM integrations emerge as priority for estate agencies
summary:
Integration capabilities are becoming a critical factor for estate agencies when selecting CRM systems, with 39% of agents identifying integrations as a major frustration. Kerfuffle has launched a directory featuring 309 integration partners and a free CRM Matcher tool to help agencies evaluate compatibility with existing technology.
